nodes.title: Blank-page start: PMs copy an old document
nodes.quote: Seven of eight PMs said they start a PRD by copying the last one they wrote.

nodes.title: Drafts ship without a measurable success metric
nodes.quote: Six of eight PMs said the success metrics section is the part they rewrite or skip.

nodes.title: Documents go stale as decisions are made in Slack
nodes.quote: Five PMs said documents are out of date within two weeks of kickoff because decisions are made in Slack and never written back.

nodes.title: Cross-functional teammates (design and engineering)
nodes.quote: Engineers and designers said they usually read the one-page brief and only open the PRD to check details.

nodes.title: PMs will trust AI-suggested metrics enough to keep them in the document

evidence.quote: Most PMs said they edit AI-suggested text heavily before sharing it with anyone.
